You know what idempotency, retries, eventual consistency and reconciliation mean in practice. - You have experience with a cloud platform, ideally Azure (AWS or GCP translates fine), and with infrastructure as code. - You’re genuinely interested in how a business makes and books money. Experience with financial systems (billing, revenue, ERP) is a plus. - You’re proactive, self-directed and hungry. You take ownership of a system and thrive with a lot of autonomy in a fast-moving, high-growth company.
